README.md:30:- **Real-time data:** The data in the Klimadashboard application is updated in real-time, providing users with the latest information on climate and environmental indicators in the city of Münster.
README.md:48:- **Open Data Portal of the City of Münster:** The City of Münster provides open data on climate and environmental indicators in the city.
docs/2-opencode.md:26:Data fetching is handled in the `postinstall` script. This script retrieves data from various sources, primarily from the repositories mentioned above. The fetched data is then copied to the `assets/data` folder, where it is subsequently consumed by the tiles.
